svg.text: GHOSTED: The Panel, body map v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)

Decided before the sheet: proportions, landmarks, the table and seat heights, attachment points (bow + band, flat-top, glasses, pens, marker, box icon), and a check at the game camera (26 m, pitch 42).
A. FRONT (upright, symmetric; world heights in units, 1 u = 3.33 mm)
head top (cap) 1.26 m H 378
hairline H 366
eye line = ear points H 326
chin H 276
shoulder joint H 244
forearms + hands on the table H 230
TABLE TOP 0.733 m = 0.75 x Kit H 220
seat (hidden) H 150
floor H 0
Kit 0.977 m (to scale)
B. SIDE (Whiteboard alone + table + chair): the depth
z (toward you): table front edge +90, back edge -90;
torso axis -140 (its front -92, at the back edge);
chair back -192. Forearms lie ON the table top
(z -78 to -26), hands meet at z -26.
PROPORTIONS
Heads: the Juno head (96 u = 0.32 m tall, 108 wide): the same size as Kit's head (0.977 / 2.71 =
0.36 m). Read of the brief: the seated head is Kit-SIZED (see notes.md Open 1).
Seated: shoulders 24 u (8 cm) above the table top, chin 56 u above it, cap top 1.26 m.
Table 600 x 30 x 180 u (2.0 x 0.1 x 0.6 m, BMGD) + a front panel and two side panels (a 'panel' desk).
The box: 100 x 90 x 80 u (0.33 x 0.30 x 0.27 m) on the table top, right seat, back to the back edge.
LANDMARKS (blue)
Eye line H 326; eyes at x +-18 from each head axis; ears on the eye line at the head sides (+-55).
Hairline high and clean (y 64 frame = H 366): nothing on the forehead, nothing beside the eyes.
Shoulder joints +-56 (Culture Fit, soft round) / +-60 (Whiteboard, square). Elbows rest on the table.
Mouth zone x 138-162, y 122-140 (frame). Rest: closed line. Grin / talk: Ricky style.
ATTACHMENT POINTS (magenta)
Culture Fit: cream band over the crown ear to ear (behind the hairline, z -16); bow CENTRED on the
crown (y 46); low bun at the nape (hidden at the front).
Whiteboard: flat-top block on the skull (y 38-60, z -46..+34), front edge 4 u above the hairline;
glasses on the eye line, arms to the ear points; pocket (2 pens) on his left chest.
Marker: in his RIGHT hand (viewer's left): lies on the table at rest, upright (click), forward (point).
The Camera-Off One: the icon is a decal centred on the box front (0.82 of the face); swap: camera /
mic / off. Lean pivot: the box's bottom front edge.
E. GAME CAMERA CHECK (x3). Left: the set + Kit in front. Right: landmark dots.
Head (cap top to chin) at 1x: Culture Fit 21.1 px, Whiteboard 21.1 px; Kit's head (0.36 m) about 20 px by the same measure.
Forehead band at 1x: CF 6.23/6.6/6.23 px, WB 6.23/6.6/6.23 px (rule 4+).
Temples: side hair 6.24 px above the eye top; flat-top front edge 1.05 px above the hairline.
Read: a round head with a cream bow over a lilac cardigan, a square brown flat-top with glasses
over a navy vest, a black cube with a cream icon, on a pale table; Kit in front, smaller.
